faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Got questions? We've got answers. Find everything you need to know about using Neargrab.

items.question: What is Neargrab and how does it work?
items.answer: Neargrab is a local commerce platform that connects neighborhood shoppers with nearby brick-and-mortar retail stores. You can search for products, check their real-time availability at local shops, read trusted neighborhood reviews, and navigate to the store using integrated directions to pick up your purchase immediately.

items.question: Is Neargrab free to use for shoppers?
items.answer: Yes, Neargrab is completely free for shoppers! We don't charge any subscription fees, convenience fees, or transaction markups. You pay the exact same price as listed inside the physical store.

items.question: How do you ensure store information is accurate?
items.answer: We work closely with local shop owners who update their inventory status regularly. Additionally, our community features allow customers to report status updates, keeping stock availability and opening hours extremely reliable.

items.question: Can I buy products directly through the Neargrab app?
items.answer: Neargrab is designed to facilitate local, in-person shopping to support your neighborhood economy. You browse and reserve products through the app, then visit the physical store to complete the purchase, touch/feel the product, and take it home instantly.

items.question: How do I leave a review for a local shop?
items.answer: Once you visit a shop, open their profile page on Neargrab and click the 'Write a Review' button. You can rate your experience, upload images, and write details about product quality and customer service.

items.question: What should I do if a product shown in stock is actually sold out?
items.answer: While we strive for absolute real-time accuracy, occasionally a product might sell out before a shopkeeper can update their inventory. You can report a discrepancy directly on the store profile page, helping us keep the database updated.

items.question: How do I list my shop on Neargrab?
items.answer: Registering as a shopkeeper is quick and easy! Click the 'Start Your Journey as a Shopkeeper' button in the navbar or footer, fill out your store profile details, set your location, and start uploading your product inventory instantly.

items.question: Are there any listing fees or commissions for sellers?
items.answer: We offer a generous free tier that allows neighborhood stores to list their profile and essential catalog. For large-scale inventories and advanced marketing tools, we have low-cost premium plans with absolutely zero commissions on your sales.

items.question: Can I sync my existing POS or e-commerce inventory?
items.answer: Yes! Neargrab supports bulk Excel/CSV inventory uploads, and we provide modern API integrations to sync directly with popular point-of-sale (POS) systems and e-commerce platforms like Shopify or WooCommerce.

hero.heading: Connecting Neighborhoods, Empowering Communities
hero.description: Neargrab was founded with a single mission: to build a seamless digital bridge between local brick-and-mortar stores and modern convenience-driven shoppers. We believe the heart of every neighborhood lies in its physical retail stores.

whyNeeded.heading: Why Neargrab is Needed
whyNeeded.description: In a world dominated by global e-commerce giants, local shops are increasingly marginalized. Neargrab acts as a localized digital interface that brings neighborhood inventories right to your screen, protecting local businesses and local jobs.

items.title: Supporting the Local Economy
items.description: Every purchase made from a local retailer circulates money within the neighborhood, directly supporting local families and neighborhood facilities.

items.title: Instant Shopping Gratification
items.description: Why wait 2 to 3 days for standard e-commerce delivery? Find the item in a store 5 minutes away, buy it, and enjoy it immediately.

items.title: Environmental Sustainability
items.description: By shopping locally, you completely eliminate the massive carbon footprints associated with long-haul shipping and excess delivery packaging.

items.title: Unrivalled Product Trust
items.description: Nothing beats the physical experience. Browse and hold the product inside the physical store before completing the purchase.

vision.heading: Our Vision & Values
vision.description: We are guided by a set of core principles that put the interests of neighborhood retailers and local consumers first.

items.title: Community First
items.description: We build tools that foster trust, connectivity, and direct relationships between shoppers and merchants.

items.title: Absolute Transparency
items.description: Real-time stock levels, honest community reviews, and direct merchant interactions without hidden algorithms.

items.title: Zero Transaction Friction
items.description: No hidden platform markups or convenience fees for customers, and easy, commission-free options for local stores.
